description: Update the configured ad account settings. Only provided fields will be modified.

account_id.description: Ad account ID to update (e.g. 'act_123' or '123'). Falls back to META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID env var if omitted.

spend_cap.description: Account spend cap in currency cents (e.g. '100000' = $1000.00)

name: update_ad_account
